newsitem.title: UK: Latvia expects 1997 GDP growth of 4-5 pct-official.
newsitem.headline: Latvia expects 1997 GDP growth of 4-5 pct-official.

text.p: Latvia's gross domestic product (GDP) growth in 1997 will be between four and five percent, Latvia's finance minister Roberts Zile said on Monday.
"In 1997, GDP growth is expected to reach four to five percent," he told the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).

Zile said the 2.5 percent increase in GDP during 1996 was largely generated by Latvia's resurgent private sector, adding that the country had achieved a stable macroeconomic environment and economic indicators pointed towards sustained growth.
In February, Latvia's finance ministry forecast 1998-99 GDP growth at an average of 3.3 percent with a maximum of six percent possible.
